name: raccoon
title: Raccoon
description: macOS companion toolkit: disk, memory, ports, battery, network and a security audit, powered by the rcc CLI.
author: eugenio

preferences.name: sudoSession
preferences.title: Admin Session
preferences.description: How long one Touch ID covers every Raccoon command. Apply it with the Configure Admin Session command.

preferences.name: rccPath
preferences.title: Raccoon CLI
preferences.description: Full path to the rcc binary. Leave empty to search the usual Homebrew locations.

commands.name: index
commands.title: Search Raccoon Commands
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Browse and run every rcc subcommand.

commands.name: disk
commands.title: Show Disk Space
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Volumes, how full they are, disk health and network mounts.

commands.name: memory
commands.title: Show Memory Usage
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Memory pressure and the processes using the most RAM.

commands.name: ports
commands.title: List Open Ports
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Open TCP and UDP ports with the process behind each one.

commands.name: battery
commands.title: Show Battery Health
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Battery health, cycle count and charging status.

commands.name: audit
commands.title: Run Security Audit
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Run the Raccoon security audit. Asks for admin rights via Touch ID.

commands.name: admin-session
commands.title: Configure Admin Session
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Ask for Touch ID once instead of once per privileged command.

commands.name: trash
commands.title: Show Trash
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Trash size, item count and where it lives.

commands.name: wifi
commands.title: Show Wi-Fi Networks
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: The network you are on and the ones this Mac remembers.

commands.name: overlap
commands.title: Map PATH Overlaps
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Which manager is behind each PATH entry, and which names clash.

commands.name: docker
commands.title: Show Docker Status
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Containers, images, volumes and reclaimable disk.

commands.name: history
commands.title: Show Shell History
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: How much each shell has recorded, and the last commands run.

commands.name: certs
commands.title: Show Certificates
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Keychain certificates, expired and expiring first.

commands.name: startup
commands.title: Show Startup Items
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: What this Mac starts on its own: login items and launch agents.

commands.name: fonts
commands.title: Show Fonts
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Where fonts live, duplicates, and any the system cannot read.

commands.name: env
commands.title: Check Environment
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: PATH entries, broken symlinks, duplicates and tool versions.

commands.name: network
commands.title: Show Network
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Your address, who resolves your names, and anything in between.

commands.name: xcode
commands.title: Show Xcode Status
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Build caches worth reclaiming, simulators still running, what is installed.

commands.name: backup
commands.title: Show Backup Status
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Whether this Mac is backed up, and how long ago.

commands.name: git
commands.title: Check Git Repositories
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Repositories with work that is not committed, not pushed, or not on a branch.

commands.name: ssh
commands.title: Check SSH Keys
commands.subtitle: Raccoon
commands.description: Private keys with no passphrase, wrong permissions, or no public half.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
